question: Who built the famous Red Fort in Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shah Jahan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Red Fort**, located in Delhi, was constructed by **Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan** in **1638**. It served as the main residence of the Mughal emperors.
 
• Shah Jahan shifted his capital from **Agra** to **Shahjahanabad** (Delhi) and commissioned the construction of the Red Fort as part of his new capital city.
 
• The Red Fort is a brilliant example of **Mughal architecture**, showcasing a combination of Persian, Timurid, and Indian architectural styles.
 
• The fort is built using red sandstone, giving it its iconic name, and it is known for its intricate carvings, decorative floral designs, and grand halls.
 
• The **Diwan-i-Aam** (Hall of Public Audience) and **Diwan-i-Khas** (Hall of Private Audience) within the fort are renowned for their architectural magnificence.</li&
